summary: Frontend testing of US jurisdiction features. All 13 test scenarios passed. Tested: jurisdiction switch (ZA→US), currency auto-sync ($USD), 4 new US calculator routes, dashboard SA/US filtering, Income/Expense US categories, Net Worth Tracker $ currency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All US jurisdiction features tested and working. Test admin user has premium access so GatedCalculator was bypassed for all 4 new US calculators. The jurisdiction selector is in the header (ZA/US button). Switch persists within session but NOT across browser sessions (localStorage-based). Next agent should verify non-premium user sees upgrade gate for US calculators.

jurisdiction_switch_to_us.details: Header shows 🇺🇸 US and $ USD. Dashboard subtitle updates to 'for Americans'. Badge shows 'United States • 2024/2025 Tax Year'

currency_auto_sync_to_usd.details: Currency in header auto-changes from R ZAR to $ USD when switching to US jurisdiction

roth_ira_calculator.details: Loads with full functionality: inputs (age, income, filing status), growth breakdown chart, milestone table, 'Why Roth IRA?' educational section. Shows $ amounts.

social_security_estimator.details: Loads with: Birth Year input, Average Annual Earnings ($), Years Worked, Marital Status dropdown, Claiming Age slider. Shows Monthly/FRA/Max benefits comparison table with break-even points.

hsa_calculator.details: Loads with: Current Age, Coverage Type, Federal Tax Bracket (22%), State Tax Rate slider, Annual Contribution slider, Current HSA Balance. Shows Triple Tax Advantage section and Growth Projection.

529_college_savings.details: Loads with: Child's Age, College Type dropdown, Years of College slider, College Cost Inflation. Shows Total College Cost, 529 at College, Funding Gap, Tax Savings with progress chart.

dashboard_us_mode_sa_tools_hidden.details: All SA-only tools hidden: TFSA Calculator, Living Annuity, RA Tax Savings, SA Tax Hub, SA Tax Calculator

dashboard_us_mode_us_section_visible.details: US Tax & Retirement Calculators section visible after Investment Calculators. Shows 6 US tools: US Tax Calculator, 401(k) Calculator, Roth IRA Calculator, Social Security Estimator, HSA Calculator, 529 College Savings.

dashboard_sa_mode_sa_tools_visible.details: SA mode: TFSA Calculator visible, Retirement Planning Suite visible, US Tax section hidden

bond_renamed_mortgage_us.details: US mode: Bond card shows 'Mortgage Calculator'. SA mode: Bond card shows 'Bond / Mortgage Calculator'

income_expense_expense_categories_us.details: US expense categories: Housing/Rent, Transportation, Food, Utilities, Phone, Healthcare, Health Insurance, 401(k) Contribution, HSA Contribution, Education/529, Entertainment, Travel, Shopping, Business Expense, Other (15 total)

income_expense_income_categories_us.details: US income categories: Salary/W-2 Wages, Bonus, Investment Returns, Rental Income, 1099/Freelance Income, Social Security, 401(k)/IRA Distribution, Other Income (8 total)

net_worth_tracker_usd.details: Net Worth shows $0.00 in US mode. All cards (Assets, Liabilities, Net Worth) show $ prefix. Input fields show $ prefix. No ZAR/R currency visible.

income_expense_tax_hint_22pct.details: Tax deductible hint shows '22% federal rate' (was 31% in SA mode). Visible in Overview tab.
